notes.title: Release Date Announcement 🥳
notes.notes:
Hey drivers! Breaks are for cowards - are you ready to race with us?

Get ready to drive – Funtasia launches on September 15th, 2022 on PC and Switch! 🎉

[previewyoutube=-0ZtIVWzSmc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your support throughout development! We’re super excited to show you everything we’ve accomplished - we hope you’re just as excited to see it as we are to show you.

You can show us your excitement by joining our community on Discord or following us on Twitter while you wait for launch!
